headline: Was I not enough for him to stay?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NEVER SUPPLY HIS REASON — not scared, not overwhelmed, not 'he couldn't cope', not 'he left because', not 'the reason he'. The reason lives in a man who did not give it, and inventing one hands her something false to act on. 🔴 Never a verdict on his person, 🔴 never invent a third person, and 🔴 note that 'it was never about you' and 'he was protecting you' are banned too — they are motive claims wearing reassurance. 🔴 No tactic in either direction: no reaching out, no one last message, no blocking, no no-contact. 🔴 No promise of closure.

🔴 THE COMPARISON IS REFUSED, NEVER SCORED — and that includes the kind direction. 'You were more than enough' feels generous and is still a claim about why he went, which is a claim nobody here can make. So the read declines to weigh her at all, and names the scale itself as the thing that was handed to her.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — there is no set of scales anywhere on his table.
You asked what was lacking in you. Your hand went to the man with no scales at all.
So I won't weigh you, dear. Not up, and not down.
And there's nothing on that table to measure with, dear. No scales at all.
But a person leaving isn't a score against you, dear.
That's why the sums never come out, dear. Someone handed you that scale.
Let me look closer at what put that scale in your hands…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — nothing on this card is being weighed against anything.
You asked if you fell short. Your hand went to the card that measures nobody.
So there's no scoring here, dear. None to be had at all.
And there's no scale under him, dear. Nobody is being weighed.
But your question needs a reason, dear, and nobody gave you one.
That's why you supplied one yourself, dear, and you picked you.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping you on that scale…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — he carries no list and no ledger.
You asked if you fell short. Your hand went to the one who counts nothing.
So he keeps no accounts, dear. Neither will I.
And there's no tally in that bundle, dear. He counts nothing.
But why a person goes is no measure of who was left, dear.
That's why it never adds up, dear. You've been reading it as a mark.
Let me look closer at what has been sitting on that scale…
